name: Dudes of Destruction
caption: A newly formed pairing of Lance Voltar and Blake Hamilton, released from their VXW contracts after a triple-threat tag loss to Team Essington at Vegas Violence V ended their run in the promotion.

name: The O'Malleys

tenures.note: Ambushed Morris Bass and Kevin Simmons on their own way to the ring for a VXW Tag Team Championship match on Sin City Fights November 27, winning by disqualification when Simmons chair-shotted Marcus O'Malley; both men were left with a Durham Deathdrop and a Widowmaker after the bell. Lost to The Dierdorfs by disqualification on New Year's Eve of Destruction 2006 after valet Delila slipped Brian Dierdorf a riding crop behind the referee's back.

caption: A brother tag team who, joined for one night by a returning Justin Harper, beat The Outlaw Morris Bass and Kagedo on Xtreme Prejudice VII. Chased Kagedo off Justin Harper on Setting Sun I, then challenged for the VXW Tag Team Championship against Hot Property on Christmas Comes Early in a Tornado Tag Team match that ended in a double-pin with no official decision rendered. Lost a scored Irish Street Fight for the VXW Tag Team Championship to Hot Property on New Years Eve Of Destruction, then confronted Chris Wheeling on Winter War I and helped clear his hired men from the ring during Adam Jennings's own match. Beat Chris Wheeling's own hired hands in a No DQ Tornado match on Winter War II, then, billed as the Society of Doom alongside Adam Jennings, beat Thunder Valenkov and Hot Property on Winter War III to earn a shot at the VXW Tag Team and 24 Hour Championships at Ghost Town Blues.

name: Purgatory
caption: PsyKlone and Synn's own tag team, fighting through a punishment match, a number one contenders bout and a losing three-way title match at Vegas Violence V before a no-contest against Team Brittania, then winning a four-way tornado tag over Hot Property, Team Brittania and the Rodeo Boys at Fear Is Coming II. Won a second straight gauntlet fall over Team Brittania at Fear Is Coming III before losing to Marcus O'Malley and Kagedo, then lost a three-way tag to Tap Out City alongside Team Brittania at Phear Phantastic 2005. Teamed with Team Essington to beat a patched-together Rodeo Boys/Tap Out City side by submission on Christmas Comes Early, with a debuting Tanara Skott's own interference against Kenny Kidd setting up the finish. Survived a returning Sebastian's chair attack to win a triple threat by referee stoppage over the Rodeo Boys and Team Essington on New Years Eve Of Destruction, then beat Sebastian himself, in his own in-ring return, on Winter War I. Lost to Sebastian and a debuting Miles McKinley on Winter War II after PsyKlone's own blindside attack forced an illegal tag.

name: Team Brittania

tenures.note: Debuts by inserting itself into a VWF Tag Team Championship match already underway between champions Mark McQueen and Thunder Valenkov and challengers Frank O'Shea and Billy Bones at St Patricks Day Massacre (17 March 2005), Simon Davidson pinning O'Shea to win the titles after Justin Davidson pulls Valenkov from the ring to stop a cover. Retains the titles by disqualification against McQueen and Valenkov at End Of March (30 March 2005) after the returning Hot Property run in on McQueen; a legal challenge filed the same night argues the team was never a signed, named participant in the St Patricks Day match and so could not legitimately win the championship, left for the VWF's incoming ownership to decide. Defends the titles, billed with a question mark over its own legitimacy, against a returning Henry Fish (billed Scott Starring) and an unidentified stand-in wrestling as the absent Van Wild at The Gauntlet 2005 (11 April 2005), winning by pinfall; the team's own hired ring announcer, not the broadcast's regular ring announcer, declares the team champions afterward.

caption: Brothers Justin and Simon Davidson, fighting Hot Property to a draw and Purgatory to a no-contest before winning a three-way match by disqualification at Vegas Violence V without taking the VXW Tag Team Championship, then losing a four-way tornado tag to Purgatory at Fear Is Coming II. Won gauntlet falls over the Rodeo Boys, Purgatory and Team Essington at Fear Is Coming III before losing to Marcus O'Malley and Kagedo, then lost a three-way tag to Tap Out City alongside Purgatory at Phear Phantastic 2005. Fought the Rodeo Boys to a no-contest on Winter War III after Team Essington's own four-man run-in, earning a spot in a fatal four-way for the VXW Tag Team Championship at Ghost Town Blues.

name: Hot Property

tenures.note: Wins the VWF Tag Team Championship from the Rodeo Boys in a Flashback ambush on Firestorm (27 May 2004), then eliminated from the Dog Day One tag team battle royal before winning the Dog Days Tag Team Elimination match. Wins the Dog Day Two tag bracket's first round over Sonicman and Sebastian, then joins Flash in beating down the Rodeo Boys during a special Flashback on Dog Day Three (1 July 2004) before competing in the sixteen-man tag scramble. Returns to the VWF at Ghost Town Blues (17 February 2005), interrupting the retiring Sebastian and G-Gangsta's own post-match celebration and attacking them, only for both Legends to fight the pair off with a Legend Killer and a Gangsta Smash. Runs in on Mark McQueen during his own VWF Tag Team Championship challenge with Thunder Valenkov at End Of March (30 March 2005), Stevie Knight and Austin Lee hitting the Property Boom to help champions Team Brittania escape by disqualification. Wins a VWF Tag Team Championship match against Mark McQueen and Thunder Valenkov, the previous champions, at The Gauntlet 2005 (11 April 2005), when Valenkov turns on his own partner McQueen; a returning Chris Wheeling reveals himself as the agent behind the turn and presents the team new contracts.

caption: "All That" Austin Lee and "Hotstuff" Stevie Knight, the reigning VXW Tag Team Champions, retaining the titles by disqualification against Purgatory and Team Brittania at Vegas Violence V, then losing a non-title four-way tornado tag to Purgatory at Fear Is Coming II. Both men entered the Rage In The Cage main event at Phear Phantastic 2005 as co-champions; Austin Lee pinned his own partner Stevie Knight for the match's own first fall, an outcome the broadcast leaves unresolved as to the tag titles' own status. The promotion's own management publicly rejected a stripping rumor on Setting Sun I, confirming Hot Property retained the titles; the team then survived a Tornado Tag Team title defense against The O'Malley Brothers on Christmas Comes Early that ended in a double-pin with no official decision rendered. Retained the VXW Tag Team Championship in a scored Irish Street Fight over The O'Malley Brothers on New Years Eve Of Destruction, Chris Wheeling's own hired men delivering the deciding points. Ran in against the O'Malley Brothers on Winter War II, then teamed with Thunder Valenkov on Winter War III in a losing effort against the Society of Doom that cost the trio a shot at the tag and 24 Hour titles at Ghost Town Blues.

name: Team Essington
caption: A masked luchador and a big man from West Virginia, debuting under the management of Essington Sports Inc with wins over Javier King and Matt Payne, over Dudes of Destruction and a student pairing in a three-way, and over the reunited Rodeo Boys. Lost a gauntlet fall to Team Brittania at Fear Is Coming III (their own final match together); released from Essington Sports Inc soon after and replaced under the same team name by a wholly new pairing, a seven-foot Mr. Smith and a four-foot Mr. Jones, who lost a debut match to the Rodeo Boys by disqualification at Phear Phantastic 2005. A masked third man, Mr. Jefferson, debuted on Setting Sun I and helped Smith beat Kenny Kidd; the now three-man team, fielding Smith and Jefferson, then teamed with Purgatory to beat a patched-together Rodeo Boys/Tap Out City side by submission on Christmas Comes Early. Fielded Mr. Jefferson, Mr. Smith and Mr. Jones in a chaotic triple threat against the Rodeo Boys and Purgatory on New Years Eve Of Destruction, then beat the Rodeo Boys outright on Winter War I after the referee missed a Rodeo Boys tag. Beat a debuting masked lucha team, Los Diablos, on Winter War II, then ran in as a four-man unit, fielding a newly introduced fourth member, Mr. Sal, to break up a Rodeo Boys/Team Brittania match on Winter War III and demand a VXW Tag Team Championship shot.

name: Tap Out City
caption: Rabid and Tyler Rude's own tag team, winning a three-way match over Team Brittania and Purgatory to earn the next VXW Tag Team Championship shot. Paired with the Rodeo Boys after Team Brittania no-showed Christmas Comes Early, losing an eight-man tag by submission to Team Essington and Purgatory.

name: Los Diablos
caption: A masked VXW Academy lucha team, losing a debut against Team Essington's three-man lineup on Winter War II.

name: Wheeling's Thugs
caption: Chris Wheeling's own two hired hands, losing a No DQ Tornado match to the O'Malley Brothers on Winter War II and running interference again for Wheeling's side on Winter War III.

name: Society of Doom

tenures.note: Continued under the same name with Justin Harper taking the place of the departed Adam Jennings, billed together as a trio ahead of the Phear Phantastic 2006 Rage In The Cage main event.

caption: Marcus and Anthony O'Malley's own stable with Adam "The Hype" Jennings, named on commentary during Winter War II's own post-match brawl and billed by name for a six-man main event against Thunder Valenkov and Hot Property on Winter War III, winning to earn a shot at the VXW Tag Team and 24 Hour Championships at Ghost Town Blues.

name: KAOS
caption: Dynamo and Heavy J, billed as veterans of the Dog Days and Twelve Days Tournaments, debuting in VXW by ambushing Team Essington from the crowd and winning by disqualification.

name: The Polish Powers
caption: Papa Joe Popovich and Stan Klenski's own tag pairing, running in to help The O'Malleys during a battle royal, beating Team Brittania by pinfall, and wrestling Purgatory to an interrupted no-contest across three broadcasts.

name: The Dierdorfs

tenures.note: Beat The O'Malleys by disqualification on New Year's Eve of Destruction 2006 after valet Delila slipped Brian a riding crop. Jumped Roman Anderson and John Manning from the crowd before Anderson's own non-title bout against Kris Dierdorf on Sin City Fights February 7, costing Kris the match by disqualification when Brian and Delila jumped in.

caption: Kris and Brian Dierdorf's own debuting tag pairing, managed by Delila, beating John Manning and Roman Anderson in their first match after Manning declared it a tornado bout and fled.

name: POT
caption: Lark Fenriz and Foodstamp's own tag team, formed when the returning Fenriz recruited a visiting KAWF wrestler on-air and immediately targeted the VXW Tag Team Championship.

tenures.note: Lost to Joey Young and Tom Rogers by disqualification on New Year's Eve of Destruction 2006 after Foodstamp threw the referee over the top rope, then were run off by a returning Rodeo Boys. Lost to the same returning Rodeo Boys by pinfall (the Eight Second Ride) on Sin City Fights February 7.

name: The Outcasts
caption: Roman Anderson and John Manning's own tag pairing, minted the moment they dethroned 'The Outlaw' Morris Bass for the VXW Tag Team Championship.

tenures.note: Billed as The Outcasts from the moment John Manning pinned champion Morris Bass with a schoolboy at New Year's Eve of Destruction 2006. Survived a Dierdorfs ambush framed as a title shot on Sin City Fights February 7, though the match itself was fought as a non-title Roman Anderson singles bout, won by disqualification after Brian Dierdorf and valet Delila jumped in; Manning cleared the ring afterward with his own title belt.
